# Feature: Golden Artifact + Schema-Compatibility

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-13 — issue #9 -->

## Intent
Slice 1 is complete only when a full `run-artifact.json` from store + analysis + rules is read back as a golden. Older minors stay readable; unknown majors are rejected (T-010, NFR-009, EDGE-012).

## Preconditions
- `packages/schemas`, `artifact-store`, `analysis`, `rule-engine`, `evidence` exist
- No browser measurement, no HTML report UI

## Happy Path
- [ ] A golden `run-artifact.json` is written and re-validated by Store + Schema
- [ ] Compatibility: unknown major → reject; additive unknown field → accept
- [ ] `pnpm test` covers this path with no network
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Artifact newer than CLI (unknown major) yields a readable compatibility error (EDGE-012)

## Regression
- [ ] Existing packages and `pnpm checks` stay green
- [ ] Scope: `packages/schemas/fixtures/**`, `tests/golden/**`, vitest include

## Assumptions
- Schema 1.0.0 is the first minor; forward-compatible additive fields within major 1 are accepted
- Golden fixtures contain no secrets
- Live pipeline (analysis → rules → evidence → store) produces the committed v1.0.0 golden

## Security Coverage
- No secrets in fixtures
- Auth/upload checklist: out of scope

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- Committed `packages/schemas/fixtures/golden-v1.0.0.json` is the schema-minor golden (T-010).
- `tests/golden/build-run-artifact.ts` composes analysis → evidence → rules-web → bind, then the test writes via artifact-store and parses again.
- Unknown major `2.0.0` fails with the EDGE-012 message; additive fields pass via schema `.passthrough()`.
- No network; Vitest include covers `tests/golden/**/*.test.ts`.
